summary: Citation delivered for Frantic bounty #128: a public, human-readable page listing AI startup credit offers sourced from the Sourcey open data registry now lives at https://wminno.github.io/agentcredits-landing/. The page serves as text/html (GitHub Pages, 200 OK, 9553 bytes, sha256 154549c82ebfa4fc4b97c11758289f9c098632dda1a28929d8726f35711ea1ec, fetched 2026-10-30) and links the Sourcey registry plus seven per-vendor Sourcey record pages (anthropic, cerebras, fly-io, mongodb, openrouter, surrealdb, zitadel), each carrying its offer ID, observation date, and the Sourcey release digest (0604c0bbf89e2983b3449b80c2775c90e6d1b3fa1757de4a275d3b9f09551e48) this page was built from. The page discloses that offers change and that eligibility rules apply, and links the machine-readable registry JSON. A byte-identical mirror of the page is archived at https://files.catbox.moe/mawtfq.html as a receipt.
